children: The annual inflation rate in Turkey rose to 27.95% in August 2026 from 27.83% in the previous month.
Costs increased for manufacturing (29.68% vs 28.96% in July) and water supply (29.59% vs 28.85%).
Meanwhile, prices eased in mining and quarrying (38.88% vs 41.81%) and electricity, gas, production and distribution (7.57% vs 11.69%).
By industrial groupings, price growth continued for intermediate goods (27.41% vs 26.79%), durable consumer goods (28.54% vs 26.57%), energy (27.33% vs 26.62%), and capital goods (22.06% vs 21.28%).
In contrast, price growth moderated in non-durable consumer goods (30.28% vs 32.46%).
On a monthly basis, producer prices rose 2.57% in August from 1.52% in July, the highest in three months.

title: Turkey Producer Inflation Edges Up in August
